en.topic_title: Chinese activist Zhang Xinyan, wanted by Hong Kong gov’t, finally arrives in Canada after Thailand detention
en.topic_summary:
Chinese activist Zhang Xinyan, who is wanted by the Hong Kong government, has finally arrived in Canada after being detained in Thailand ahead of her scheduled flight.



Sheng Xue, a Chinese Canadian activist who has been trying to assist Zhang, said on Facebook on Wednesday that the activist arrived at Vancouver International Airport on Monday morning, Canadian time.



A wanted notice on the Hong Kong police’s website for Zhang Xinyan. Screenshot: Hong Kong Police Force.
